blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Tomorrow is another day at Czarnikow. To talk about the future, English uses "will + verb". For example: I will help, she will call, we will meet. It is that simple!

Today you will learn 5 important words: tomorrow, next week, plan, prepare, and send. We go step by step. You can do it!

Here is a dica: English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. The future starts today.

items.q: What does English use to talk about the future?
items.why: "English uses 'will + verb'" — é a regra da lição: will + verbo.

items.q: How many new words will you learn today?
items.why: "Today you will learn 5 important words."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which sentence?
items.why: Inferência: o texto é positivo ("You can do it!"), então discorda de "impossible".

items.q: "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts" suggests that the author wants you to…
items.why: Inferência: a frase é de encorajamento — foco no que você PODE fazer.

items.q: Which sentence is a correct example of will + verb?
items.why: "will + verb": will call. As outras não seguem a estrutura da lição.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie contando o plano de amanhã para o time de RH. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello team. Let me tell you the plan for tomorrow. It will be a busy day, but a good day. I am happy to work with you.

First, I will send the schedule to you tonight. Please read it before you sleep. Tomorrow morning, we will meet at nine. The meeting will be short, only thirty minutes. Please arrive on time.

After the meeting, Tom will help me with the new report. We will prepare it together. I will call the manager at eleven, and she will answer our questions.

In the afternoon, we will start the plan for next week. We have many new people this month. I will prepare a welcome email, and then we will send it to them. Every new person will feel happy here.

We will finish everything by five. Then you can go home and rest. Thank you, everyone. Tomorrow will be a great day, and next week will be even better!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What time will the team meet tomorrow morning?
items.why: "Tomorrow morning, we will meet at nine."

items.q: Who will help Sophie with the new report?
items.why: "Tom will help me with the new report."

items.q: When will Sophie send the schedule?
items.why: "I will send the schedule to you tonight."

items.q: Why does Sophie send the schedule tonight?
options: So the team can read it before the meeting
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "Please read it before you sleep" — para o time chegar preparado.

items.q: How does Sophie feel about tomorrow?
items.why: Inferência: ela tem um plano claro e diz "Tomorrow will be a great day".

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I will call you tomorrow." Tomorrow means…
items.why: Tomorrow = amanhã, o dia seguinte.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I am busy today, so we will meet ___."
items.why: Next week = semana que vem, um tempo no futuro.

items.q: "We need a good plan for the project." A plan is…
options: an idea of what to do
items.why: Plan = plano: a ideia do que você vai fazer.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I will ___ the report before the meeting."
items.why: Prepare = preparar; é o verbo que completa "will + verb".

items.q: "She will send the email now." To send means…
options: to make something go to someone
items.why: Send = enviar: fazer algo chegar até alguém.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples do dia a dia de RH. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I will send out the schedule tonight." To send out means to…
items.why: Send out = enviar para várias pessoas (o time todo).

items.q: "Let's set up a meeting for tomorrow." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = organizar, marcar (uma reunião).

items.q: "I will follow up with you next week." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = retomar, checar de novo mais tarde.

items.q: "Please fill in this form for HR." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher (um formulário) com as informações.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the plan." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.
